title: Executive Administrative Assistant
description:
Part-Time | Remote | Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–1:00 PM Eastern Time



We are seeking a highly organized, dependable, and resourceful Executive Administrative Assistant to work directly with firm leadership and provide day-to-day administrative and operational support.



This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys being the person behind the scenes who keeps everything moving. The ideal candidate is not simply a task completer. You are someone who notices details, remembers what needs to be followed up on, asks questions when necessary, and naturally thinks about what should happen next.



The position is 20 hours per week, Monday through Friday from 9:00 AM–1:00 PM Eastern Time. We are looking for someone interested in building a long-term working relationship and becoming a trusted member of our team.



What You'll Do



This role will touch many different aspects of the firm's administrative and operational work. Some responsibilities will be recurring and highly structured; others will involve figuring out something new.



Your responsibilities may include:



- Managing calendars, scheduling meetings and appointments, and coordinating competing priorities

- Preparing, proofreading, editing, formatting, and organizing documents and correspondence

- Drafting routine
s and other communications based on instructions, templates, and established firm practices

- Maintaining organized electronic files, folders, and records

- Working within Google Drive and other cloud-based platforms

- Preparing forms, applications, spreadsheets, trackers, and other administrative materials

- Maintaining internal databases, spreadsheets, and project-tracking systems

- Reviewing documents carefully for accuracy, completeness, consistency, and formatting

- Conducting online research and presenting findings in a concise, organized format

- Assisting with client onboarding and administrative follow-up

- Tracking deadlines, open items, outstanding information, and follow-ups

- Communicating with vendors, service providers, and other third parties as needed

- Assisting with internal projects and improvements to firm processes

- Following established SOPs and helping maintain and improve them (possibly drafting new ones as well)

- Learning and working with new software, technology, and systems

- Providing general administrative support to firm leadership

- Taking on new projects and responsibilities as the firm's needs evolve



You may occasionally be asked to research something you've never encountered before, organize a disorganized set of information, troubleshoot an administrative issue, or help create a process where one does not yet exist.



We do not expect you to know everything. We do expect you to be willing to learn, think critically, ask appropriate questions, and figure things out.



What We're Looking For



The right person will take genuine pride in being organized, accurate, responsive, and dependable.



You are likely to be a strong fit if you:



- Have exceptional attention to detail and routinely catch errors others might miss

- Follow through reliably and do not need to be reminded repeatedly about outstanding tasks

- Can keep multiple priorities organized without losing track of details

- Communicate clearly and professionally in written and spoken English

- Are comfortable following detailed instructions and established procedures

- Can exercise sound judgment when instructions do not address every situation

- Work well independently in a remote environment

- Know when to ask a question rather than make an assumption

- Take initiative and look for the logical next step

- Keep track of projects and open items through completion

- Treat confidential information with discretion

- Learn new technology, software, and processes quickly

- Accept and implement constructive feedback

- Look for ways to make processes more efficient and organized

- Take ownership of your responsibilities rather than waiting for someone else to manage them



Reliability, communication, and judgment are especially important to us. We want to be able to delegate something to you with confidence that it will be handled carefully, that you will follow through, and that you will let us know if something requires additional attention.



Experience



Previous experience as an executive assistant, administrative assistant, legal assistant, office manager, customer service professional, or in another professional services environment is helpful.



However, we are more interested in how you work than in your job title.



Strong organizational ability, attention to detail, professionalism, initiative, written communication skills, and a strong work ethic are more important to us than having a particular background.



You do not need to have experience in our industry. We are willing to train the right person on our systems, processes, and industry.



Schedule 

Monday–Friday

9:00 AM–1:00 PM Eastern Time

20 guaranteed hours per week

Remote position

Consistent availability during the scheduled hours is required

Additional hours may become available as the firm's needs grow

Potential for expanded responsibilities over time



This is intended to be a long-term position, rather than a short-term or temporary assignment.



For the right person, the role can grow substantially. As you learn our systems and become familiar with how we work, we expect you to take on more responsibility and operate with increasing independence.



How to Apply



Please read these instructions carefully. Your ability to follow instructions is an important part of this position. Applications that do not provide the requested information may not be considered.



Please include all of the following in your application:



- A brief introduction explaining why this position interests you and why you believe you would be a strong executive administrative assistant.

- A summary of your relevant experience, including administrative, executive assistant, legal, customer service, professional services, or other applicable experience.

title: Grant Writer & Funding Coordinator – Nonprofit / Social Impact
description:
Part-Time | Remote | Long-Term Opportunity



About GIVE Society



GIVE Society is a luxury social club with a purpose. We bring together professionals, entrepreneurs, community leaders, and brands through unforgettable experiences that cultivate meaningful connections while creating opportunities and resources for foster youth.



Our mission is simple: create unforgettable experiences that fund unforgettable futures.



As GIVE Society grows, we are looking for a resourceful and detail-oriented Grant Writer & Funding Coordinator who can help us identify and pursue funding opportunities for our organization, foster youth initiatives, community programming, and future events.



This is not a role where we simply provide you with a list of grants to write.



We are looking for someone who can research opportunities, determine our eligibility, develop strong applications, submit grants, and maintain an organized funding pipeline.



What You’ll Be Responsible For



Grant Research & Qualification



Research local, state, national, corporate, and foundation grant opportunities



Identify grants aligned with foster youth, education, community development, young adults, social impact, and related initiatives



Research corporate giving programs and community grants



Review eligibility requirements before recommending opportunities



Prioritize grants based on fit, potential funding amount, deadline, and likelihood of alignment



Identify recurring grant opportunities we can pursue annually



Grant Writing & Applications



Write compelling grant applications tailored to each funder



Draft letters of inquiry, proposals, organizational descriptions, program narratives, impact statements, and funding requests



Adapt our existing mission, programs, budgets, and organizational materials for different applications



Complete online grant applications and required forms



Help gather and organize supporting documents needed for submissions



Proofread applications for accuracy, consistency, and professionalism



Submission & Follow-Up



Submit completed applications when authorized



Track application deadlines and submission statuses



Maintain a grant calendar and funding pipeline



Track requested amounts, awarded amounts, declines, pending applications, and follow-up dates



Identify reporting requirements for successful grants



Follow up on applications when appropriate



Funding Strategy



Help us determine which types of grants are most realistic for GIVE Society



Identify gaps in our materials that may prevent us from qualifying for funding



Recommend opportunities we should prepare for in advance



Help develop reusable grant language and an organized grant library for future applications



What We’re Looking For



You may be a great fit if you:



Have previous nonprofit grant writing or grant research experience



Have personally completed and/or submitted grant applications



Know how to research foundations, corporations, and community funding opportunities



Can determine eligibility without needing constant direction



Write persuasive but accurate applications



Are highly organized and deadline-driven



Are comfortable working independently



Can communicate clearly when additional information or documentation is needed



Understand that every funder requires a different approach rather than copying and pasting the same proposal



Are comfortable using Google Drive, Google Docs, Google Sheets, and online application portals



Can maintain a clear funding tracker or CRM



Experience with U.S.-based nonprofits, corporate giving programs, foster youth organizations, education, community programs, or event-based nonprofits is a strong plus.



What Success Looks Like



We do not measure success solely by the number of applications submitted.



We want:



Qualified funding opportunities



Strong, complete applications



Consistent submissions



An organized grant pipeline



Clear communication about deadlines and requirements



Funding opportunities that genuinely align with GIVE Society



A repeatable grant process we can continue using as the organization grows



To Apply



Please do not send only a generic cover letter.



Include the following in your application:



1. Tell us about your grant writing experience.

What types of organizations and grants have you worked with?



2. Give us an example of a grant you personally helped secure.

What was the grant amount, what type of organization was it for, and what part of the process did you personally handle?



3. Walk us through how you would find grants for GIVE Society.

Based on our focus on foster youth, community impact, professionals, entrepreneurs, and experiential fundraising, where would you begin?



4. How do you determine whether an organization is actually eligible for a grant before spending time on the application?



5. How many well-researched grant opportunities/applications could you realistically manage each month?



6. What tools or databases do you typically use for grant research?



7. Please provide 1–2 writing samples or examples of previous grant proposals, with confidential information removed if necessary.



8. Tell us your hourly rate and weekly availability.



Please begin your application with the words “GIVE GRANTS” so we know you read the full posting.



Why Join GIVE Society?



This is an opportunity to help build the funding infrastructure of a growing social-impact organization—not simply complete one-off grant applications.



The right person can grow with us as we expand our foster youth initiatives, partnerships, annual GIVE Gala, and additional GIVE Society experiences.



We’re looking for someone who is proactive, resourceful, organized, and genuinely enjoys finding opportunities other people overlook.

title: Sales Closer & Appointment Setter for a Web Studio (Salary + Commission)
description:
Hi, I'm Victor. I'm French and I run Vicou Studio on my own: I design and build custom websites and web apps for all kinds of businesses, from barbers, bakeries and local craftsmen to bigger companies.



THE ROLE IN ONE SENTENCE

You find business owners who need a new website, you talk with them, and you bring them to me once they've said yes: they know what they want, they've agreed to the price, and they're ready to start.



HOW WE SPLIT THE WORK

Your part:

- Find businesses that are doing well but have a weak website (none, outdated, not working on mobile), anywhere in the world

- Spot the ones that already pay for booking or coaching software: they're a great fit for a custom app

- Reach the owner or decision maker, the way you're most comfortable with:
, phone or LinkedIn

- Talk with them and really understand their needs: every website is different, and it has to fit the client's business

- Handle their objections and get their agreement on the project and the price

- Introduce them to me once they're ready, with a clear written summary of each call or exchange: what they need, what they expect, their budget



My part:

- One kick-off call or WhatsApp exchange with the client, only to gather the project details

- The quote, the contract and the deposit

- Designing and building the website



I'm not a salesperson, and I want to spend my time building. That's why I'm looking for someone who closes, not just someone who books meetings because I could books meeting by myself.



WHAT YOU GET FROM ME

- My offers and prices, so you can talk about them with confidence

- For prospects who are clearly interested: a short preview (one or two screens of what their new website could look like) to help them d

- Examples of my work: 
 (custom website + web app for a fitness coach), vicou.studio (my studio), and screenshots of a yoga studio booking app on request



A BIT ABOUT ME

I've built a lot of websites over the years on Shopify and WordPress. Today, thanks to AI-assisted development, I'm no longer limited to a CMS: I write custom code and deploy it directly, with no template limits, and much faster. Shopify stays my choice for online stores, because it's easier for clients to manage.



ABOUT THE BUDGET

My projects are priced in the thousands of dollars. That doesn't mean big companies only: a barber or a bakery that's doing well can invest in a custom website too. But you need to be comfortable talking about that kind of budget with a business owner.



HOW YOU WORK

- Every message goes out under Vicou Studio, so it has to be clean and personal: no mass copy-paste, no spam. At the start, we review the messages together before they're sent

- Feel free to use AI tools, I use them a lot. But I'm not looking for scraped lists: I can build those myself. I'm looking for the human part: the conversations that turn into clients

- Quality over volume: a few well-chosen prospects beat hundreds of random messages



WHO I'M LOOKING FOR

- Proven experience in sales, closing or appointment setting, ideally for a web, marketing or digital agency

- Experience selling offers in the thousands of dollars

- Strong at handling objections, the big ones and the basic ones: "it's too expensive", "I already have someone", "I'll think about it"... You don't give up at the first "meh": you understand what's behind it and bring the conversation back to what the client needs

- An eye for websites: you can tell an outdated one, and a business that's doing well

title: Short-Form Video Editor – High Volume, Fixed Monthly Pay
description:
You get stable monthly income, a clear repeatable process, and a long-term role on a fast-growing content studio working with multiple German creators (10K to 100K+ followers).



We're a content studio producing short-form video for German Instagram and TikTok creators in the business/coaching niche. We're scaling content volume across several accounts right now, with major product launches coming for multiple creators later this year.



What the job looks like

You edit short-form vertical videos (45-90 seconds) for Instagram Reels and TikTok. The format is consistent and repeatable: the creator speaks to camera, you remove the background in CapCut, drop in AI-generated images behind them, and sync them to the talking points.



Every video follows the same template. Once you learn it, editing is fast. A good editor will finish 5-10 clips per hour, with basic color grading applied to each one.



Expected output is around 180 clips per month across the accounts you're assigned to.



This is fully async work. You receive footage and assets in Google Drive, edit, and upload exports back. No daily calls, no time zone pressure — but you need to be reachable on WhatsApp, and either work ahead of deadlines or be genuinely available every day of the week.



What you earn

$200/month fixed to start, paid reliably every month. After 30 days of reliable delivery, your rate at least doubles.



At 5-10 clips per hour, this works out to roughly $5-11 per hour of actual editing time to start — and it only goes up from there. The faster and more consistent you are, the better your effective rate.



What this role can become

We have more work than we can currently handle, across multiple creators and formats. If you deliver quality work and grow with us, there's room for a lot more volume, more responsibility, and meaningfully better pay — well beyond the starting rate. This isn't a "try it for a few weeks" gig. We want someone in it for the long run.



What you need



- CapCut desktop — you already use it or can learn it fast

- Basic color grading skills (or willingness to learn — we'll show you)

- Reliable internet and a computer that handles CapCut without issues

- You can follow a written workflow in English and communicate clearly about editing details — a lot of what makes this work well is understanding specific notes and feedback, so solid written English matters

- Willingness to use AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT) to understand the German source footage well enough to edit it precisely — we have a clear process for this, you just need to be willing to work with it. Already having your own ChatGPT account is a plus, but not required.



You do not need to speak German yourself.



Quick gut check before you apply: it's Saturday evening and a Reel urgently needs to go out. How do you handle it? We're looking for people who either work ahead or are genuinely available through the week — not just during "office hours."



To apply

Send a short message with:



- 2-3 examples of short-form Reels or TikTok videos you've edited

- Your typical turnaround time from raw footage to finished export

- Confirmation that you have CapCut desktop

- A one-sentence answer to the Saturday-night scenario above



Put "PILOT" at the start of your subject line so we know you read the whole post.



Shortlisted applicants complete a short paid test task before we finalize anything.

title: Full-Funnel Digital Marketer — Content, Socials, GHL, GA4/GTM, Automation (n8n) & AI (Claude)
description:
10 hrs/week to start, scaling to 15–20 after probation (potential to grow to full-time)



ABOUT KILOWATT SOFTWARE

Kilowatt Software designs, builds and operates AI-first products. We believe modern agentic systems only work when they stand on robust data, an explicit orchestration layer, and a well-designed ontology that gives agents something structured to reason over.



We run lean, move fast, and lean heavily on automation and AI to multiply what a small team can do. We're looking for someone who thinks the same way.



ABOUT THE ROLE

This is a hands-on digital marketing role for someone who can develop content, automate high-quality organic posting and run integrated campaigns end-to-end — paid, organic,
, automation, and analytics — and who treats AI as a force multiplier rather than a replacement for judgment.



You will own day-to-day execution across our marketing stack: building and tuning automations in GoHighLevel, watching the numbers in GA4, managing our presence on Meta and YouTube, and running the loops that turn audiences into engaged users and paying customers.



You won't be siloed into one channel or task. We need someone who can develop strategy, execute their plan, and leverage the tools available to them (which are many).



WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Build pipelines to drive content generation across our digital footprint, leveraging automation and AI with a human voice

- Run integrated digital marketing campaigns across paid, organic,
, and automation channels for our two primary properties

- Build, maintain, and improve automations in GoHighLevel (workflows, pipelines, triggers, tags,
/SMS sequences)

- Connect and orchestrate tools using n8n as part of the broader automation stack

- Track and report on performance using GA4/GTM, Meta Business Suite, YouTube Studio, and other social/monetization back-ends

- Manage paid social and creator monetization back-ends; understand what each platform actually rewards

- Build audience, drive engagement, and convert leads into paying customers across the full funnel

- Use AI tools daily to accelerate research, drafting, content production, segmentation, and analysis (AI augments you — it doesn't think for you)

- Engage with parents and educators across our channels with a warm, trustworthy tone when needed

- Bring back what you're hearing from the audience so the product team can act on it



REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE



- Demonstrated experience running integrated digital marketing campaigns (not just one channel)

- Strong working knowledge of GoHighLevel, GA4, Meta Business Suite, and YouTube Studio

- Hands-on experience building automations, especially in GHL, plus comfort with Zapier, Make, or n8n

- Fluent and intentional use of AI tools in your daily workflow

- Track record of building audience, driving engagement, and converting leads into paying customers

- Strong written English with a clear, natural, friendly tone

- Good judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently



NICE TO HAVE



- Recent experience with brands or platforms targeting parents and teachers

- Background in education, parenting, family, or EdTech

- Experience supporting a small brand, startup, or founder-led team



HOW WE MEASURE SUCCESS



- Campaigns ship on time, with measurable results

- Automations are reliable and improving over time

- Funnel metrics (engagement, lead-to-customer conversion) move in the right direction

- AI is visibly accelerating output without sacrificing quality

- The audience experience feels human and trustworthy



WORKING STYLE



- Self-directed and accountable — comfortable owning outcomes without daily supervision

- Curious about new tools, but disciplined about which ones earn a place in the stack

- Treats AI as a power tool: leverages it heavily, reviews everything, owns the final output

- Communicates clearly and honestly about what's working and what isn't



WHAT WE'RE OFFERING



- 10 hours/week to start, scaling to 15–20 after a successful probation period

- Strong preference for someone who wants to grow with us — this role can become full-time over time

- Direct collaboration with the founder and a small, capable core team

- Real ownership of the marketing stack, not a checklist of tasks



HOW TO APPLY



Please include:

- A short note on the kind of work you most enjoy and where you do your best work

- One or two examples of integrated campaigns or automations you've built or run, with results if you can share them

- A quick description of how you currently use AI in your workflow

- Confirmation of availability between 8 am and 4 pm EDT/EST

title: Creative Strategist / VSL Video Creative for US Pet Supplement Brand
description:
Summary

# Creative Strategist / VSL Video Creative for US Pet Supplement Brand



We’re a fast-growing, US-facing *pet supplement e-commerce brand* looking for a talented *Creative Strategist / Video Creative* to join our team long-term.



Our main focus is *high-converting VSL-style video content*, but we also produce a wide range of direct-response creatives across Meta, TikTok, YouTube and other platforms.



We’re looking for someone who understands that great performance creative isn’t just about making a video look good.



*The hook, angle, emotion, pacing, storytelling and structure matter just as much as the edit itself.*



Our brand is heavily focused on *emotion-first storytelling*. We sell the feeling and transformation behind the product, rather than simply listing product features.



What you'll be working on



You'll help us create and develop:



•⁠  ⁠VSLs and longer-form direct-response videos

•⁠  ⁠Short-form video ads

•⁠  ⁠UGC-style creatives

•⁠  ⁠Hooks and different opening variations

•⁠  ⁠New creative angles and concepts

•⁠  ⁠AI-assisted creatives

•⁠  ⁠Social-first content for Meta, TikTok, YouTube, etc.

•⁠  ⁠Variations and iterations of winning creatives



You should be comfortable taking a concept or brief and turning it into a finished piece of content — while also bringing your own creative ideas and strategic thinking to the table.



What we're looking for



You should have:



•⁠  ⁠Experience creating VSLs and/or direct-response video ads

•⁠  ⁠Strong understanding of hooks, pacing and storytelling

•⁠  ⁠Experience with e-commerce brands

•⁠  ⁠Excellent video editing skills

•⁠  ⁠Strong written and spoken English

•⁠  ⁠Experience using AI tools/platforms in your creative workflow

•⁠  ⁠Ability to work quickly without sacrificing quality

•⁠  ⁠Strong attention to detail

•⁠  ⁠Reliable internet connection

•⁠  ⁠Ability to handle feedback and iterate quickly



Experience in the pet, supplement, health or wellness space is a big plus.



Compensation



•⁠  ⁠Starting rate: $3–$5/hour

•⁠  ⁠We’ll begin with a probation period

•⁠  ⁠Strong performers can grow into a larger role with more responsibility and higher compensation (*$6–$8/hour initially, with room to grow further*)

•⁠  ⁠We're looking for someone interested in a long-term position, not just a one-off project



How to apply



Please apply directly through Onlinejobs and answer the screening questions included with this job post.



Generic applications will not be considered.



We care much more about real examples, relevant experience, results and how you think than polished wording.



If you've created VSLs or direct-response ads that performed well, please include examples of your work in your Onlinejobs application and explain what you personally contributed to each project. If you are really interested please add a # behind your name.



Please be as specific as possible in your answers. We're looking for someone who understands both the creative strategy behind an ad and the execution required to bring it to life.



All application and pre-contract communication will take place through Onlinejobs.







We’re looking forward to seeing your work.

title: Senior WordPress + AI + SEO Developer Needed for Large Content-Driven Sign Company Website
description:
We are an established sign and graphics company based in Brooklyn, NY, serving NYC, Long Island, and parts of New Jersey.



We are looking for an experienced WordPress developer/web strategist to work closely with us to build a large, professional, SEO-focused website.



This is NOT a basic 5–10 page website.



Our goal is to build a high-content website with many service, product, industry, location, portfolio, and informational pages while keeping the website easy to manage and expand.



Reference Website



Please study:







This is an important reference for the type of website structure and content depth we want.



We DO NOT want to copy their website, design, branding, or written content.



We want to build our own stronger, modern website using their website as a reference for:



Website depth



Service page structure



Product categories



SEO architecture



Location pages



Industry pages



Internal linking



Portfolio/project organization



Content strategy



Our website should ultimately contain a large amount of useful content while remaining organized, fast, modern, and easy to maintain.



Company



Epic Signs & Graphics



Services include:



Storefront Signs



Channel Letters



Light Box Signs



Awnings



Dimensional Letters



Lobby Signs



Window Graphics



Wall Graphics



Vehicle Wraps



Vehicle Lettering



Large Format Printing



Banners



Posters



Decals



CNC Routing



Laser Cutting



Sign Installation



Sign Repair



Sign Permits



Plaques & Awards



And other commercial signage and printing



We serve businesses throughout NYC, Brooklyn, Queens, Manhattan, Long Island, and surrounding areas.



What We Need



We want someone who can help us architect and build the entire website, not someone who needs us to provide every page and instruction.



You should be able to look at the reference website, understand our business, and help determine the best way to structure our site.



Website Architecture



We expect categories such as:



Signs



Printing & Graphics



Vehicle Graphics



Services



Industries



Locations



Portfolio / Projects



Blog / Resources



We eventually expect the website to grow to 100–300+ quality pages.



The website needs to be designed so this amount of content is manageable.



Dynamic WordPress System



We strongly prefer a system using technologies such as:



WordPress



Bricks Builder, Elementor, Gutenberg, or similar



Advanced Custom Fields (ACF)



Custom Post Types



Dynamic templates



Reusable components



Global styles



Structured content fields



We DO NOT want 200 individually designed pages that become impossible to maintain.



For example, one Service Page template should be capable of powering many different sign-service pages while allowing unique content, photos, FAQs, specifications, galleries, and SEO information for every service.



The same concept should apply to:



Locations



Industries



Projects



Products



Materials



Portfolio / Project Database



This is especially important.



We have a large amount of real completed sign work.



We want to upload a completed project once and categorize it by things such as:



Sign Type



Industry



Location



Material



Illumination Type



Service



That project should then automatically appear on relevant pages throughout the website.



For example, a Brooklyn restaurant channel-letter project could automatically appear under:



Channel Letters

Restaurant Signs

Brooklyn Signs

Illuminated Signs

Portfolio



without manually uploading the project five times.



AI EXPERIENCE IS IMPORTANT



We want someone who understands how modern AI tools can make managing a large website easier.



We would like to create workflows where we provide basic information about a project or service and AI can assist with:



Initial page drafts



Project descriptions



FAQs



Image alt text



SEO titles



Meta descriptions



Internal linking suggestions



Schema



Content briefs



Blog drafts



Human review will still be required.



We are NOT looking to mass-publish low-quality AI pages.



We want AI to make producing quality content faster.



SEO EXPERIENCE IS REQUIRED



You should understand:



Technical SEO



Local SEO



Service-area SEO



Internal linking



Website silos



Schema markup



Google Search Console



XML sitemaps



Canonicals



Breadcrumbs



Page speed / Core Web Vitals



Image optimization



Location-page strategy



Service-page strategy



Avoiding duplicate/thin AI content



Experience building websites for local service businesses is highly preferred.



Experience with contractors, signage, construction, home services, printing, manufacturing, or similar businesses is a major plus.



Performance



A large website cannot become slow because of excessive plugins.



You should understand:



Caching



CDN



WebP / AVIF



Image compression



Lazy loading



Database optimization



Clean WordPress architecture



Core Web Vitals



Collaboration



The owner will be involved with:



Business knowledge



Photos



Completed projects



Products/services



Pricing knowledge



Competitor/reference websites



Final approvals



However, the developer should be able to lead the technical project.



We need someone who can say:



"This is how I recommend structuring it."



rather than constantly asking us:



"What do you want me to do next?"



You should be comfortable collaborating with us and using AI tools such as ChatGPT/Claude where appropriate during development.



Initial Project



The first phase will likely include:



Competitor/reference-site analysis



Complete sitemap



SEO architecture



WordPress architecture



Design system



Homepage



Main service templates



Location template



Industry template



Project/portfolio system



Blog/resource system



Quote/contact system



Initial core pages



Mobile optimization



Technical SEO



Analytics/Search Console



Performance optimization



Launch



After the initial website is completed, there may be ongoing work expanding the content library.



IMPORTANT WHEN APPLYING



Please do NOT send a generic proposal.



Start your response with:



EPIC SIGNS



Then answer these questions:



Send 3 websites you personally built that are closest to this project.



Have you built a WordPress website with 100+ pages?



Have you used Custom Post Types and Advanced Custom Fields?



How would you structure a site like 
 so hundreds of pages remain manageable?



What AI tools/workflows would you use to help us create and manage content?



Describe your experience with local SEO.



Would you recommend Bricks, Elementor, Gutenberg, or another WordPress stack for this project, and why?



How would you structure our portfolio so one project can automatically appear across relevant service, industry, and location pages?



What would you do differently or better than the reference website?



Are you personally completing the work, or will it be outsourced to another developer/team?



Give us an estimated project timeline and budget range based on the description above.



We are looking for someone interested in becoming a long-term technical partner, not simply completing a template website and disappearing.



Please only apply if you have completed comparable large WordPress projects and can show them.

title: Supply Chain Operations Specialist
description:
About HammerHead®

HammerHead® is a DTC brand making solid metal plumbing fixtures: shower heads, shower systems, filtration, and next up, bathroom faucets. We sell on Amazon and Shopify, primarily in the US and growing Canada presence. We're on pace for $25M in 2026 with a path to $100M by end of 2029.



We build for the long term. Real products, real margins, small team where every hire matters.



The Role

Airtable is the core of our system — every purchase order, SKU, shipment, unit cost and landed cost lives there, feeding forecasting, purchasing and COGS reporting. ClickUp runs the day to day, Google Drive holds the file library, and more than twenty Claude skills automate work across all of it. You'll run those skills daily. The more important part is judging whether what comes back is right — a skill that imports a purchase order still needs someone who knows what a correct purchase order looks like.



You own the operational execution layer of our supply chain department: SKUs and their data across every system, PO and payment administration, the integrity of our cost and inventory data, and the reporting that runs off it. Our SOPs are standardized and we expect them to be followed exactly, but the job takes a professional eye on the data underneath. This isn't a button-clicking role.



What This Seat Owns



SKU Operations

- Own the SKU lifecycle — creating records in Airtable, generating UPC barcodes and FNSKUs, and running SKU rollovers end to end

- Manage product label updates for SKU changes with the designer, keep packaging file records accurate across Drive, Shopify and Airtable, and verify barcode and SKU accuracy before files go to suppliers



Purchase Order and Payment Administration

- Issue purchase orders to suppliers, and calculate the component requirements that go with them

- Review proforma invoice costs and enter them against PO lines in Airtable

- Own the paperwork behind purchasing — payment records filed across Drive, Airtable and ClickUp, supplier confirmations, inspection reports, monthly AP reconciliation and vendor credit documentation



Data Integrity

- Run weekly inventory validation across every location in our supply chain

- Own cost accuracy — reconciling open and historic POs, keeping cost data correct in Airtable and our other platforms, and verifying landed cost by SKU and by model

- Keep product specification data current and the Google Drive file library organized to standard

- Act as a second set of eyes on the dataset, and escalate anomalies before they compound



Reporting and Monitoring

- Assemble the data behind our weekly forecast outlier review and monthly FIFO and COGS reporting

- Update the monthly trackers for our KPIs

- Monitor stock in/out status and communicate it across the business

- Maintain per-product lead time data in Airtable



Who We're Looking For



Requirements

- Strong understanding of how a supply chain flows end to end

- Hands-on experience running purchase order and supplier administration — issuing POs, entering supplier costs, tracking what's been paid and what hasn't, and chasing paperwork until it's filed correctly

- Strong Excel and Google Sheets skills — you work comfortably with exports, lookups and reconciliation

- Exceptional attention to detail. Non-negotiable.

- You check what a system hands you before you act on it. A number arriving from a tool doesn't make it right.

- Advanced English, C1 or above, written and spoken

- Strong organizational skills — you self-manage and see things through without being chased

- You follow documented process exactly, and question it rather than assuming it's right

- You say something is wrong the moment you find it, rather than working around it quietly

- Hungry to learn, and you bring ideas

- This is a full-time role, not one engagement among several. We expect you to be present and on time during working hours.

- 3+ years in supply chain, purchasing or purchase order administration



Nice to Have

- Fluent in Airtable — comfortable working in a relational base, though not at developer level

- Experience in Amazon Seller Central

- Experience with imported goods or overseas manufacturing supply chains

- A bookkeeping or accounts payable background

- Day-to-day use of AI tools in your current work



Compensation and Structure

- Compensation: 1,200–1,500 USD per month, with room to grow based on performance

- Bonus: 13th month if the company hits conservative annual growth targets

- Type: Full-time independent contractor

- Location: Remote

- Working hours: 40 hours/week, Monday–Friday, with a minimum 4 hours of daily overlap with our core business hours (9:00 AM–5:00 PM EST)

- Reports to: Head of Supply Chain

- Start date: ASAP

- Paid leave: 10 days in your first year, pro-rated. 15 days from year two, and one extra day for every year after that. Capped at 20 days.

- Equipment: You provide your own computer, reliable headphones and dedicated home workspace

- Long-term: We hire for the long haul. 2 weeks notice each way. Severance eligibility after 6 months.



Hiring Process

1. Apply for the job directly in  the Online Jobs platform. Include your resume and a short 2-3 minute Loom video that answers:

    - Brief introduction

    - A system you used to manage COGS or accounts payable

    - Why this role interests you

2. Complete a written questionnaire

3. Interview with the Head of Supply Chain

4. A paid, role-specific test task

5. Final interview with the CEO

, YouTube and other relevant platforms.



• Develop social media concepts, content ideas, hooks, captions, carousels, graphics and campaigns.



• Create and edit short-form and longer-form video content for social media, websites and campaigns.



• Use Higgsfield and other AI video platforms to create high-quality and visually engaging content.



• Turn raw footage, photos, scripts or simple ideas into polished social media content.



• Understand video storytelling, pacing, hooks, transitions, framing, B-roll, music, captions and platform-specific editing.



• Create engaging Reels, Shorts and other short-form video formats.



• Repurpose existing content into multiple social media and video formats.



• Identify trends, formats and creative opportunities relevant to different clients.



• Create and improve captions, headlines, hooks, scripts and other marketing content.



• Support lead generation activities, campaigns, landing pages and conversion opportunities.



• Create graphics, carousels and other social media assets.



• Monitor social media and content performance.



• Turn performance data into practical recommendations for future content.



• Use ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and other AI tools for research, ideation, scripting, content creation and productivity.



• Build or support practical automations using n8n, Make, Zapier or similar tools.



• Automate areas such as content repurposing, research, reporting, lead collection and repetitive marketing tasks.



• Coordinate with developers, designers and other team members.



What We Are Looking For



• 2+ years of practical experience in social media, digital marketing, video editing, content creation or a related field.



• Strong social media knowledge and a clear understanding of what makes content perform.



• Strong video editing and video content creation skills.



• Experience creating short-form social media videos, Reels, Shorts or similar formats.



• Strong practical experience with tools such as Higgsfield, CapCut, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve or similar platforms.



• Experience using AI video and AI creative tools.



• A good visual eye and understanding of composition, typography, pacing, storytelling and branding.



• Ability to turn a simple idea, raw footage or written concept into engaging content.



• Understanding of different social platforms and how content should be adapted for each one.



• Good understanding of lead generation and conversion-focused marketing.



• Strong written English.



• Experience with Canva or similar creative tools.



• Strong practical use of AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini.



• Some experience with n8n, Make, Zapier or similar automation tools is valuable.



• Strong organisation, ownership and ability to manage several priorities.



Experience with Meta Ads, Google Ads, YouTube optimisation, CRM integrations, AI agents, APIs or other marketing automation tools is an advantage.



You do not need to be an expert in every area.



However, social media content creation and video editing should already be areas where you can demonstrate strong practical skills.



How We Work



We are looking for someone who:



• understands the objective behind a task;



• takes ownership instead of waiting for detailed instructions;



• combines creative thinking with commercial understanding;



• has a strong visual sense for social media and video;



• understands what makes people stop scrolling;



• can turn ideas into engaging content;



• can work across different social media platforms;



• follows developments in social media, AI video and digital marketing;



• actively experiments with new AI tools and creative workflows;



• looks for ways to improve and automate processes;



• is comfortable testing ideas and learning from performance.



A question we want you to ask regularly is:



“Can this be done better, faster or more intelligently?”



Commitment & Compensation



This is a full-time, long-term role working 8 hours per day.



Reliable overlap with European working hours, CET/CEST, is required.



Starting compensation is USD 500 per month, full time, with room to grow over time based on performance, responsibility and overall fit.



To show us that you have read the complete job description, include the word “GROWTH” in the first sentence of your application.



How to Apply



Please include:



• A short introduction and your relevant experience.



• Your location, time zone and availability.



• Your experience with social media content creation and management.



• Your experience with video editing and AI-generated video.



• Which video and creative tools you use regularly.



• Your specific experience with Higgsfield, if applicable.



• Examples of social media accounts, campaigns or content you have worked on.



• An example of how you helped improve engagement, reach, leads or conversions.



• An example of an AI workflow or automation you have built, if available.



• The social media, video, design, marketing and AI tools you use regularly.



Portfolio Requirement



Please include at least 3 examples of work you personally created or played a significant role in creating.



We especially want to see examples of:



• Social media videos

• Reels or Shorts

• AI-generated video

• Social media graphics or carousels

• Campaign content

• Video editing or creative storytelling



For each example, briefly explain:



1. What the objective was.

2. What you personally created or managed.

3. Which tools you used.

4. What you would improve if you created it again today.



Links to actual videos, social media posts, campaigns or portfolio examples are strongly preferred.



Applications without at least 3 relevant examples may not be considered.



Short Expertise Question



Please answer the following question in your application:



Imagine we give you a 60-second talking-head video from a client. The information is good, but the video itself is visually boring. How would you turn it into a strong 20–30 second social media video that makes people stop scrolling?



Briefly explain:



• how you would choose the hook;



• what you would remove or restructure;



• how you would use B-roll, captions, sound and transitions;



• whether and how you would use Higgsfield or other AI video tools;



• how you would adapt the video for Instagram versus LinkedIn;



• and what you believe would make the final video perform better.



There is no single correct answer.



We want to understand how you think about content, editing, storytelling and audience attention, not simply which software you know.



We are particularly interested in understanding how you create strong social media content, produce engaging videos, use AI intelligently, generate attention and leads, and take ownership of your work.

title: Marketing & Lead Generation Specialist
description:
About the Role

The Denmarks are looking for a creative, results-driven Marketing & Lead Generation Specialist to help grow our brands, promote our events and programs, and consistently generate new leads and sales opportunities. Understanding how to set up, analyze, and run ads is extremely important for this role 



We are looking for someone who understands that marketing is about more than creating great-looking content. Your job is to help turn marketing into action—leads, registrations, appointments, ticket sales, and ultimately revenue opportunities.



If you are creative, organized, proactive, comfortable working in a fast-paced environment, and know how to take an idea from concept to execution, we want to hear from you.



What You’ll Do

- Develop and execute marketing and lead-generation campaigns.

- Create and manage promotional campaigns for events, masterclasses, webinars, programs, funding services, and other company initiatives.

- Manage social media content, including promotional posts, reels, stories, testimonials, countdowns, and calls-to-action.

- Generate leads through social media, direct outreach, digital campaigns, partnerships, referrals, and other creative strategies.

- Create and execute
 and SMS marketing campaigns.

- Build and manage campaigns, workflows, tags, and lead activity inside GoHighLevel (GHL).

- Help drive registrations and ticket sales for conferences, meetups, webinars, masterclasses, and other events.

- Engage with prospects through social media comments and DMs and help move qualified leads into the appropriate pipeline.

- Repurpose videos, testimonials, event footage, and educational content into marketing assets.

- Maintain a marketing and promotional calendar to ensure campaigns launch on time.

- Track where leads are coming from and which campaigns are producing results.

- Monitor campaign performance and recommend adjustments when results are below goal.

- Collaborate with the sales and operations teams to ensure marketing-generated leads receive timely follow-up.

- Bring new marketing and lead-generation ideas to the team rather than waiting to be told what to do next.



What We’re Looking For



We’re looking for someone who:

- Has experience in running ads, marketing, lead generation, or digital marketing.

- Understands social media marketing and audience engagement.

- Has experience with
 and SMS marketing.

- Can write clear, engaging marketing copy and strong calls-to-action.

- Understands how to generate and nurture leads.

- Is comfortable tracking numbers and being accountable for results.

- Can manage multiple campaigns and deadlines at the same time.

- Is organized, dependable, detail-oriented, and proactive.

- Can work independently while collaborating with a growing team.

- Is comfortable in a fast-moving entrepreneurial environment.



Experience with GoHighLevel (GHL), Canva, All Social Media Platforms, Event Marketing, Real Estate, Funding, Coaching, Eventbrite, or educational programs is a plus.



How Success Will Be Measured

-This is a results-driven marketing position. While consistent content and campaign execution are important, success will be measured by the results those activities produce.



Key performance areas include:

- Qualified leads generated

- Appointments generated

- Event and masterclass registrations

- Conference ticket sales

- Lead-to-appointment conversions

-
 and SMS engagement

- Social media inquiries and conversions

- Campaign performance

- Marketing deadlines met



You’ll Be a Great Fit If...

- You’re the type of person who sees that registrations are behind goal and immediately starts thinking, “What can we do differently to get more people in the room?”

- You don’t need someone to give you every marketing idea. You bring ideas, test strategies, monitor the numbers, communicate what’s working, and make adjustments.

- You understand the difference between being busy with marketing and producing results from marketing.



Ready to Apply?

- If you’re creative, proactive, comfortable with numbers, and excited about helping a growing entrepreneurial brand generate more leads and opportunities, we’d love to hear from you. 

- When applying, please include your resume and examples of marketing campaigns, social media content, lead-generation strategies, or other marketing work you have completed.

- Send a video on why you are a good fit for the job.

title: Senior / Staff Software Engineer - AI Platform
description:
Senior / Staff Software Engineer — AI Platform



Remote — Philippines | Full-time | $30,000+ annual cash base | U.S. Eastern Time



We’re looking for an exceptional senior engineer to own major parts of a production healthcare AI platform end-to-end.



You’ll work closely with our technical leadership and a small engineering team on backend systems, data integrations, AI-enabled workflows, cloud infrastructure, enterprise deployments, and production reliability.



This is a hands-on engineering role with significant architectural ownership.



You will write code, make technical decisions, review designs, debug production systems, and help establish engineering standards.



We don't want someone who waits for perfectly defined tickets.



We want someone who can take an ambiguous problem, understand the business and technical constraints, challenge assumptions, recommend the right approach, and own the solution through production.



Exact technology matches are less important than strong engineering fundamentals and the ability to learn quickly.





WHAT YOU'LL OWN



- Design and build scalable backend services, APIs, and platform capabilities

- Own major technical projects from architecture through production

- Build integrations with complex external systems and data sources

- Develop reliable data pipelines and processing workflows

- Integrate AI/LLM capabilities into production applications

- Design data models and improve database performance

- Improve scalability, security, observability, and reliability

- Diagnose difficult production issues and identify root causes

- Build and improve CI/CD and deployment processes

- Review code and architectural designs

- Establish strong standards for testing, maintainability, security, and documentation

- Work with technical and product leadership to turn requirements into scalable solutions

- Partner with customer-facing teams on complex enterprise integrations and technical deployments

- Mentor engineers and raise the quality of the engineering team





WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



- 7+ years of professional software engineering experience

- Strong backend engineering experience

- Excellent system-design and architecture fundamentals

- Experience building and operating production-grade software

- Strong experience with APIs, integrations, databases, and distributed systems

- Experience designing scalable cloud-based systems

- Strong understanding of testing, CI/CD, monitoring, logging, and production reliability

- Ability to independently solve complex and ambiguous technical problems

- Strong debugging and root-cause-analysis skills

- Excellent written and spoken English

- High ownership and attention to quality



We care more about what you have built and owned than years of experience alone.





AI EXPERIENCE



You do not need to be an ML researcher.



We're looking for a strong software engineer who knows how to build reliable production systems around modern AI.



Experience with production AI applications is strongly preferred, particularly with areas such as LLM APIs, RAG, agentic workflows, vector search, model evaluation, AI reliability, and latency/cost optimization.





CLOUD & INFRASTRUCTURE



You should be comfortable working with modern cloud infrastructure, including:



- AWS, Azure, or GCP

- Docker/containerized applications

- CI/CD

- Infrastructure as Code

- Monitoring and observability

- Secure cloud architectures

- Performance and scalability



Kubernetes experience is a plus where relevant, but we don't expect one person to be an expert in every infrastructure technology.





HEALTHCARE EXPERIENCE



Healthcare experience is a strong plus, but not required.



Particularly relevant experience includes:



EHR integrations, FHIR/HL7, Epic or Oracle Health/Cerner, clinical or claims data, HIPAA, PHI handling, RBAC, auditability, encryption, and enterprise security requirements.



In healthcare, we consider security, privacy, reliability, and auditability foundational requirements—not optional features.





THE ENGINEER WE'RE LOOKING FOR



We want a builder-operator.



Imagine you're told:



“We need to reliably integrate this data source into the platform. Figure out the right architecture.”



A strong candidate doesn't wait for a detailed specification.



You investigate the problem, ask the right questions, understand the constraints, evaluate tradeoffs, recommend an approach, and build it.



And your ownership doesn't stop when the pull request is merged.



You care about whether the system deploys correctly, performs reliably, is observable, handles failures appropriately, and works in the real world.



You know when to build for future scale—and when a simpler solution is the better engineering decision.



You should also be comfortable challenging technical decisions when you believe there is a better approach.





THIS ROLE IS NOT



This is not a:



- Ticket-taking engineering role

- Pure engineering-management position

- Pure DevOps position

- Customer-support role

- Research-only AI position



You will build software yourself while having meaningful influence over architecture and technical direction.





WORKING SCHEDULE



This is a full-time, 45-hour/week position, Monday through Friday.



The role will primarily follow U.S. Eastern Time, approximately 9:00 AM–6:00 PM ET.



Candidates based in the Philippines must already be comfortable working overnight hours.



Some flexibility may occasionally be required around major releases, deployments, or critical issues, but this is not intended to be a 24/7 on-call position.





COMPENSATION



$25,000-$40,000 annual cash base, depending on experience and technical level, plus startup equity.



For an exceptional candidate with true Staff-level capabilities, we are open to discussing compensation above this range.



We are looking for someone who can grow with the company and take on increasingly significant technical ownership.





WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



Within your first few months:



- You independently own meaningful parts of the platform

- Technical leadership doesn't need to closely supervise your implementation

- You turn loosely defined problems into production-ready systems

- Your code is reliable, maintainable, secure, and well designed

- You identify architectural problems before they become major issues

- You improve engineering standards around you

- You make other engineers more effective

- You understand the product well enough to challenge technical assumptions

- You consistently ship



Ultimately, we want technical leadership to be able to say:



“I can give this person a difficult problem and trust them to own it.”





STRONG PLUS



You've previously worked in an early-stage or high-growth B2B SaaS company where you had significant ownership, operated with limited bureaucracy, and had to move quickly without sacrificing engineering quality.





HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with:



ENGINEER100



Please send:



1. Your resume

2. GitHub, portfolio, or relevant work samples, if available

3. A short description of the most technically difficult production system you personally owned

4. One important architectural decision you made and the tradeoffs you considered

5. One serious production issue you personally diagnosed and resolved

6. Your experience, if any, building production AI/LLM applications

7. Your current location

8. Confirmation that you can work approximately 9:00 AM–6:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time

9. Your current compensation expectations



Please don't send a generic cover letter.



We're much more interested in what you've built, what you've owned, and how you think technically.
