title: JUNIOR PERSONAL ASSISTANT
description:
Hi! I'm the founder of a growing Danish e-commerce company selling kids' tech products, and I'm looking for a junior assistant to work very closely with me. I don't care about your experience, your degree, or your CV. I care about you.



If you're someone who learns fast, works hard, takes ownership, and genuinely wants to grow, keep reading.



WHAT THE ROLE IS



You'll be working directly with me and my team, but I want to be upfront: you won't start as my full personal assistant. In the meantime, the role will mainly be customer support. You'll be the person our customers write to (you have a colleague in the CS team), making sure every question, order issue and complaint gets handled properly from start to finish.



Alongside that, you'll help with operational and personal assistant-type tasks, like, following up on tasks and I promise you it will be a challenge, but you will learn a lot! As you prove yourself, more of those responsibilities will come your way, and if you perform well, there's real potential to grow into a full personal assistant role or even team manager.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



Answer customer emails and messages, and resolve questions about orders, deliveries, returns and products

Follow up with couriers and our warehouse when shipments are delayed or something goes wrong

Spot recurring customer issues and suggest ways to fix them at the source

Use AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, automation) to work faster and smarter

Help with operational and assistant tasks such as coordinating with suppliers and partners and keeping tasks organized

Whatever needs doing. The role will grow and change as you grow, and that's the point.



WHO YOU ARE



Your English is great, written and spoken. This is the only hard requirement.

You're hungry. You want more than a paycheck, you want to learn, grow, and build something.

You figure things out. When something is unclear, you don't freeze, you try, you Google, you use AI, and then you ask smart questions.

You take ownership. When you start something, you see it through.

You pay attention to details. The small things matter to you.

You're not afraid of change. New tasks and new challenges excite you.

Experience? Doesn't matter. Attitude? Everything.



WHAT YOU'LL GET



Working directly with the founder, learning how a real e-commerce business runs from the inside

Hands-on experience with AI tools that most virtual assistants never get to use

A friendly, supportive team that always has your back

$4-$7/hour starting pay with real raises when you deliver. If things are going well, your pay goes up. Simple.

Christmas bonus every year

A role that grows with you, with a clear path to becoming a full personal assistant if you perform well



HOW TO APPLY:

Send your application as an email to: Hiring@tech-shoppen.dk



We do NOT read applications sent through the OnlineJobs message system. If you apply through OnlineJobs directly, your application will not be seen. The only way to be considered is to send your application to the email above.



Your email MUST include:



Subject line: The subject line of your email must contain the word UNICORN. Not in the body of the email, in the subject line. This tells us you've actually read the full job posting. Applications without UNICORN in the subject line will be archived and not opened.

A Google Drive link to your video introduction (2-3 minutes max). Introduce yourself in English. Tell us what you like to do when you're not working. Then tell us why you're excited about this role and why you believe you're the right fit. This is how we evaluate your English and communication skills. Do NOT use a script. If we can tell you're reading from a script, your application will be disqualified, and yes, we can tell. This must be a Google Drive link, not Loom or any other platform. It should also be the only link in your email.

Your Tony Robbins DISC profile attached as a PDF. Take it for free here: tonyrobbins.com/disc. It must be the Tony Robbins assessment specifically. Attach the PDF directly to your email, do not share it as a link.

A screenshot of your typing speed attached to the email. Go to 10fastfingers.com/typing-test, complete one round of the English typing test, and attach a screenshot showing your WPM and accuracy.

If you have a resume, attach it as a PDF.



Applications that do not include all of the above will not be considered. Read carefully, because applications that miss any of these steps will be archived without review.



It sounds hard and strict, but I promise we are a friendly team and you will love working with us 😊

title: Shopify Inbound Order Specialist (Phone & Live Chat - Graveyard Shift / Call Center Exp Required)
description:
Summary

Customer Order Taker position at Carla’s Cookie Box, a Toronto-based online bakery. 



Role details:



HOURS & COMPENSATION



• 20 hours per week, Monday–Friday

• Proposed schedule: 11:00 a.m.–3:00 p.m. Eastern Time, with flexibility to agree on different start and end times

• $6–$7 USD per hour, depending on relevant experience and demonstrated ability

• Long-term position



Once we agree on a schedule, you must be consistently available for the full shift. Please confirm your availability and what the proposed hours would be in your local time.



ABOUT THE ROLE



This is a customer-facing order-taking position, rather than a general administrative VA role. Your primary responsibility will be helping new customers place regular and corporate orders accurately and efficiently through phone, live chat and
.



RESPONSIBILITIES



• Answer incoming order calls promptly and professionally

• Respond to new order inquiries through live chat and

• Answer questions about products, flavours, pricing, pickup, local delivery and shipping using our approved information

• Help customers select products, quantities and options

• Prepare regular and corporate quotes while the customer is on the phone or chat whenever possible

• Collect and verify customer details, product selections, fulfilment method, addresses and dates

• Repeat the complete order back to the customer before creating the invoice

• Create accurate Shopify draft orders and
 secure invoices and payment links

• Remain available while customers review their quotes and complete checkout

• Verify the payment status in Shopify before confirming an order as paid

• Follow up on unpaid quotes according to company procedures

• Document conversations and next steps in Re:amaze and Shopify

• Return missed order calls promptly during your shift

• Transfer existing paid-order problems, complaints, tracking inquiries, claims and refund requests to the Main VA with complete notes



CORPORATE ORDERS



• Provide product quotes during the initial conversation whenever possible

• Prepare Shopify draft orders and invoices

• Explain that shipping to multiple addresses is calculated separately

• Send the approved multi-address spreadsheet when required

• Review returned address spreadsheets for missing information

• Prepare or coordinate the complete shipping quote for return to the customer the same business day, once all required information is available



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



• Strong professional spoken and written English

• Previous phone-based customer service, call-centre, inside-sales or order-taking experience

• Confidence guiding live customer conversations

• Hands-on Shopify experience, including creating draft orders, quotes or invoices and sending payment links

• Ability to work quickly while maintaining accuracy

• Excellent attention to product options, quantities, addresses, pricing and dates

• Comfort handling phone, chat and
 inquiries during the same shift

• Reliable high-speed internet, a quiet workspace and a professional headset

• Ability to remain calm, organized and helpful when several inquiries arrive at once

• Willingness to follow detailed procedures and escalate questions rather than guess



PREFERRED EXPERIENCE



• Re:amaze, Gorgias, Zendesk or a similar support platform

• RingCentral or another business phone system

• E-commerce order management

• Corporate quoting or sales administration

• Multi-address gifting or shipping coordination

• Converting customer inquiries into paid orders



IMPORTANT REQUIREMENTS



• Customers must enter payment information through Shopify’s secure checkout. You must never collect or record credit-card details.

• No unauthorized discounts, free shipping or custom pricing.

• Shipping dates and delivery dates must be explained accurately.

• Accuracy, initiative, professional communication and dependable attendance are essential.



HOW TO APPLY — Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be considered

Please send:

1. Your updated resume highlighting your Shopify, phone customer service and order-taking experience.

2. A 60-second audio or video introduction. Tell me briefly about your previous phone/order-taking experience. This allows me to hear how you communicate with customers.

3. Answer this scenario in your own words:

INITIATIVE SCENARIO

You are speaking with a corporate customer who wants to order 20 holiday gift boxes. They are interested in ordering, but their event is approaching and they are concerned our normal shipping option may not arrive in time.

You know the following:

- You cannot promise a delivery date that has not been confirmed.

- You cannot offer an unauthorized discount, free shipping or special price.

- Pickup and local delivery may be options depending on the customer's location.

- You may contact the shipping carrier to investigate available service options.

- The Main VA is currently offline.

- You are expected to make a reasonable effort to save a potential order rather than simply telling the customer it cannot be done.

What specific steps would you take while the customer is still on the phone or chat? What would you do next if you could not immediately confirm an option?

Please do not give me a general customer-service response. I want the actual steps you would take.

title: Legal Assistant
description:
We are a growing U.S.-based law firm seeking a Legal Assistant to join our team and provide hands-on support with client matters and the firm's day-to-day legal operations.



This is an opportunity for someone who is highly organized, exceptionally detail-oriented, and interested in learning a specialized area of law. We are interested in finding someone who is intelligent, organized, curious, dependable, and capable of learning complex processes.



This position will begin at 20 hours per week, Monday through Friday from 9:00 AM–1:00 PM Eastern Time, with the potential for additional hours and increased responsibility as the firm's needs grow.



We are looking for someone interested in developing a long-term relationship with the firm and becoming someone we can rely on to help move client matters forward.



About the Role



The Legal Assistant will work closely with firm leadership and assist with a variety of legal, administrative, and client-related matters.



Because our practice is highly specialized, you will learn our processes and systems over time. The successful candidate does not need to know the answers when they start, but they must be willing and able to learn, research, follow detailed instructions, ask thoughtful questions, and become increasingly independent.



The role may include:



- Assisting with client applications and renewals

- Preparing and organizing documents for regulatory filings

- Reviewing applications and supporting documentation for completeness and accuracy

- Organizing client information and documentation

- Maintaining client files and electronic folders

- Preparing forms, spreadsheets, trackers, and other work product

- Reviewing documents carefully for errors, inconsistencies, and missing information

- Conducting legal research at the direction of the attorney

- Preparing research summaries and internal notes

- Tracking applications, submissions, corrections, deadlines, and outstanding items

- Communicating with clients regarding administrative and document requests

- Drafting routine client correspondence based on instructions or templates

- Following up with clients regarding missing information or documentation

- Assisting with submissions to government agencies

- Monitoring the status of pending applications and regulatory matters

- Organizing correspondence and documentation received from government agencies

- Maintaining internal databases, spreadsheets, and matter trackers

- Following established Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and drafting new ones

- Assisting with the development and improvement of firm processes

- Providing general support to firm leadership

- Scheduling and setting appointments

- Taking on additional projects and responsibilities as the candidate becomes more familiar with the firm



The work requires a high level of attention to detail. A seemingly small discrepancy in a name, address, ownership document, application response, or supporting document can matter, so we are looking for someone who naturally double-checks their work rather than simply checking a box.



What We Are Looking For



The ideal candidate is someone who is:



- Exceptionally organized and detail-oriented

- Reliable and consistent

- A strong written and verbal communicator in English

- Comfortable working with detailed information

- Able to follow written and verbal instructions carefully

- Comfortable working independently

- Willing to ask questions when something is unclear

- Proactive about identifying missing information or potential problems

- Able to manage multiple matters and competing priorities

- Comfortable working with confidential client information

- Curious and genuinely interested in learning

- Comfortable conducting internet and regulatory research

- Able to learn new software, systems, and procedures

- Responsive and professional in communications

- Able to receive feedback and incorporate it into future work

- Someone who takes ownership of assignments and follows them through to completion



We are particularly interested in candidates who are analytical and naturally curious. You may be given a regulatory question or an unfamiliar application and need to figure out where to look, identify the relevant information, and organize what you find for the attorney.



You should not be someone who needs every step of every assignment spelled out indefinitely. As you become familiar with our practice and systems, we expect you to become increasingly comfortable recognizing what needs to be done next.



Experience



Prior experience as a legal assistant, paralegal, regulatory assistant, compliance assistant, or administrative professional is helpful but not required. Law firm experience is preferred but not required.



Experience working in a regulated industry, professional services environment, government agency, compliance role, or another detail-oriented position may be particularly helpful.



Most importantly, we are looking for someone with the ability and willingness to learn. We will teach you our practice.



A candidate who has excellent organizational skills, strong writing abilities, good judgment, and a demonstrated ability to learn may be a much better fit than someone with years of legal experience who lacks those qualities.



Hours



- Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–1:00 PM Eastern Time

- 20 guaranteed hours per week

- Must be consistently available during the stated Eastern Time hours

- Long-term position; this is not intended to be a short-term or temporary assignment



There is potential for the position to grow in both hours and responsibility for the right person.



How to Apply



Please read the instructions carefully before applying. Attention to detail is an important part of this position, and failure to follow the application instructions may result in your application not being considered.



Please provide:



1. A brief introduction explaining why you are interested in the position and why you believe you would be a good legal assistant.

2. A summary of your relevant experience, including legal, administrative, regulatory, compliance, customer service, or professional services experience.

3. Your current resume.

4. A link to a 2–3 minute introductory video telling us about yourself, your professional background, and why you are interested in this position.

5. Your expected hourly rate in USD.

6. Your availability, including confirmation that you can consistently work Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–1:00 PM Eastern Time.

7. At least five (5) Apply Points. Applications submitted with fewer than five Apply Points will not be considered.

8. Include the word DESIGN in the subject line of your application.



Who Will Succeed in This Role?



This position is best suited to someone who enjoys learning how things work and making sure things are done correctly.



You will be working in a specialized legal practice where you will encounter unfamiliar terminology, government forms, regulatory requirements, and client situations. We do not expect you to know these things when you begin. We do expect you to be willing to learn them.



Over time, our goal is for you to become someone who understands our systems well enough to anticipate what is needed, identify missing information, keep matters organized, and help ensure that nothing falls through the cracks.



If you are dependable, highly detail-oriented, intellectually curious, and take pride in producing accurate work, we encourage you to apply.

title: Executive Administrative Assistant
description:
Part-Time | Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–1:00 PM Eastern Time | Remote



We are a growing company looking for an exceptionally organized, dependable, and proactive Executive Administrative Assistant to work closely with firm leadership and help keep the business organized and running smoothly.



This is not a position for someone who simply wants to complete a list of tasks and move on to the next one. We are looking for someone who naturally thinks one step ahead, notices when something needs attention, communicates clearly, and takes ownership of getting things done.



The position will begin at 20 hours per week, Monday through Friday from 9:00 AM–1:00 PM Eastern Time, with the potential over time for additional hours and expanded responsibilities as the relationship develops. Our goal is to find someone interested in becoming a long-term and trusted member of the team.



The Opportunity



You will work directly with firm leadership and will be involved in the day-to-day administrative and operational side of the business.



Some days may involve routine administrative work. Other days may involve researching an unfamiliar topic, organizing information, preparing documents, following up on an outstanding item, troubleshooting a process, or helping with a project that has never been done before.



We value someone who can take instructions and execute them accurately, but who can also eventually look at a situation and think:



“I see what needs to happen next.”



As you learn the firm, our systems, and our preferences, we expect you to become increasingly independent and proactive.



- Responsibilities may include:

- Managing calendars, meetings, appointments, and scheduling

- Preparing, editing, proofreading, and formatting documents and correspondence

- Drafting routine emails and other communications using instructions, templates, or established firm practices

- Organizing and maintaining electronic files and folders

- Managing information in Google Drive and other cloud-based systems

- Preparing forms, applications, spreadsheets, and administrative materials

- Maintaining trackers, databases, spreadsheets, and internal records

- Reviewing documents carefully for accuracy, completeness, consistency, and formatting

- Conducting online research and turning information into clear, organized summaries

- Assisting with client onboarding and administrative follow-up

- Monitoring deadlines, follow-ups, and outstanding items

- Coordinating with vendors, service providers, and other third parties

- Assisting with internal projects and process improvements

- Following established Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and helping keep them organized and up to date

- Learning new software, systems, and processes

- Providing general administrative and organizational support to firm leadership

- Taking on additional projects as the firm's needs evolve



This position will involve both recurring responsibilities and unexpected projects, so the ability to adapt, prioritize, and learn quickly is important.



The Person We Are Looking For



The strongest candidate will be someone who is naturally organized and takes pride in doing things correctly.



You should be someone who:



- Pays close attention to details and catches mistakes before they become problems

- Is exceptionally reliable and follows through on commitments

- Can manage several priorities without becoming overwhelmed

- Communicates professionally and confidently in written and spoken English

- Can follow detailed instructions but also knows when to use good judgment

- Is comfortable working independently

- Asks thoughtful questions when something is unclear rather than making assumptions

- Takes initiative rather than waiting to be told about every next step

- Keeps track of open items and follows them through to completion

- Is comfortable working with confidential and sensitive information

- Learns new technology and processes without becoming frustrated

- Responds well to constructive feedback

- Is interested in improving rather than simply doing things the way they have always been done

- Takes genuine ownership of their work



Reliability and judgment are particularly important to us. We are looking for someone we can trust to handle responsibilities carefully and to tell us when something requires attention.



Prior experience as an executive assistant, administrative assistant, legal assistant, office manager, customer service professional, or in another professional services environment is ideal, but strong organizational skills, professionalism, attention to detail, and work ethic are more important than a specific job title.



We are willing to train the right person on our industry, systems, and processes.



Hours 

- Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–1:00 PM Eastern Time

- 20 guaranteed hours per week

- Additional hours may become available as the firm's needs grow

- You must be consistently available during the stated Eastern Time hours

- We are seeking someone interested in a long-term position, not a short-term or temporary role



The position has the potential to grow in both hours and responsibility for someone who demonstrates strong performance, initiative, and reliability.



How to Apply



Please read the instructions carefully before applying. Following instructions is an important part of this position, and applications that do not include the requested information may not be considered.



Please submit the following:



- A brief introduction explaining why you are interested in this position and what makes you a strong candidate for an executive administrative role.

- A summary of your relevant experience, including administrative, executive assistant, legal, customer service, or other professional experience.

- Your current resume.

- A link to a 2–3 minute introductory video. Please tell us a little about yourself, your professional background, and why you are interested in working with our firm. We are interested in hearing you speak and learning a little about the person behind the application.

- Your expected hourly rate in USD.

- Your availability, including confirmation that you can consistently work Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–1:00 PM Eastern Time.

- At least five (5) Apply Points. Applications containing fewer than five Apply Points will not be considered.

- Include the word NORTHSTAR in the subject line of your application.



What Success Looks Like



We are ultimately looking for someone who can become a trusted extension of firm leadership.



In the beginning, you will receive more direction as you learn how we work. Over time, the goal is for you to understand our systems and preferences well enough that you can anticipate needs, keep track of moving pieces, identify issues, and handle responsibilities with increasing independence.



If you are the type of person who enjoys bringing order to chaos, takes pride in being dependable, notices the little things, and likes being the person others can count on, we would love to hear from you.

title: Media Buyer

What You Will Do



Your role is mainly focused on campaign execution, monitoring and account management.



You will:



* Create and launch Meta Ads campaigns based on instructions provided by our team

* Use the creatives, copy, budgets and campaign direction we provide

* Monitor campaigns daily to make sure everything is running correctly

* Check basic performance metrics such as spend, ROAS, CPA, CTR, CPM and purchases

* Identify which campaigns or ads are performing well and which are not

* Report performance and problems back to the team

* Flag anything unusual, including sudden performance drops, tracking issues or delivery problems

* Make requested campaign changes after receiving direction from the team

* Duplicate or rebuild existing approved campaign structures when campaigns need to be moved to another authorized ad account

* Make sure replacement campaigns are set up correctly and match the previous structure

* Check that budgets, targeting, creatives, tracking and campaign settings are correct after migration

* Monitor ad approvals, rejections and account-status issues

* Report account restrictions or advertising issues immediately

* Follow our internal SOPs and instructions

* Keep clear records of campaign changes and account activity



Decision Making



You are not responsible for running the overall strategy.



Your job is to manage the operational side of the campaigns, collect the data and report what is happening.



Major decisions regarding:



* Scaling

* Budget changes

* Campaign strategy

* Client strategy

* New testing directions

* Major optimizations



will be made by our team.



You may provide observations and recommendations, but final decisions will come from management.



What We Provide



* Creatives

* Ad copy

* Budgets

* Campaign strategy

* Client information

* Ad account access

* Campaign direction

* Internal SOPs

* Instructions on what should be launched, changed or tested



Requirements



* Previous Meta Ads Manager experience

* Experience creating and managing Meta campaigns

* Comfortable working with multiple client accounts

* Understand basic Meta advertising metrics

* Able to accurately recreate existing campaign structures

* Able to identify when campaigns are not delivering correctly

* Organized and detail-oriented

* Reliable communication

* Good written English

* Able to follow instructions accurately

* Able to report issues quickly

* Comfortable working in a policy-sensitive advertising industry



Experience with peptides, supplements, health/wellness or similar industries is a plus.

Compensation depends on experience and workload.



DM for payment details and more information.

title: Executive Assistant – Bookkeeping, Property Management Accounting & Owner Reporting
description:
TrueNest Property Management in Space Coast and Orlando is a growing Florida property management company managing both single-family and multifamily rental properties.



We are looking for a highly organized and dependable Executive Assistant with strong bookkeeping and financial administration skills to work directly with the President of the company.



This is not a traditional bookkeeping-only position and it is not a general VA position.



You will become an important part of our day-to-day operations and will be responsible for helping ensure that our financial records, invoices, owner balances, property accounts, and reporting are accurate and organized.



You will also serve as the primary person answering incoming company phone calls, assisting callers when possible and transferring calls to the appropriate team member when needed.



Primary Responsibilities

Bookkeeping & Buildium



A major part of this position will involve working inside Buildium, our property management software.



Responsibilities will include:

Entering and managing vendor invoices and bills

Reviewing invoices for accuracy and proper property/unit allocation

Monitoring property and owner account balances

Identifying properties with low or negative balances

Tracking unpaid or outstanding invoices

Reviewing income and expenses for unusual transactions

Helping ensure transactions are properly categorized

Assisting with owner distributions and financial records

Reviewing owner statements for accuracy

Preparing monthly owner reporting

Identifying discrepancies before statements are sent

Maintaining organized financial records

Reporting financial issues and concerns directly to the President



Previous Buildium experience is strongly preferred but NOT required.



If you have strong bookkeeping experience and are comfortable learning new software, we are willing to train the right person.



Experience with other property management/accounting platforms is also valuable.





You will work closely with the President of TrueNest and help provide visibility into the financial condition of the properties we manage.



We don't want to discover problems after they become emergencies.



You should be comfortable proactively reporting things such as:



Owner/property balances requiring attention

Outstanding bills

Unusual expenses

Missing invoices or documentation

Delinquent accounts

Owner statement discrepancies

Upcoming financial obligations

Items requiring management approval

Financial trends or issues you notice



We are looking for someone who doesn't simply enter information, but reviews it, understands it, and speaks up when something doesn't look right.





Phone & Administrative Responsibilities



You will also be the primary contact for incoming company telephone calls.



You should be comfortable:



Professionally answering calls in English

Determining why someone is calling

Assisting with basic questions when appropriate

Transferring calls to the correct department or team member

Taking accurate messages

Documenting important conversations

Recognizing urgent issues and escalating them appropriately



You will often be the first person an owner, tenant, vendor, Realtor, or prospective client speaks with, so professionalism and communication skills are extremely important.



What We're Looking For



The ideal candidate is:



Experienced with bookkeeping or accounting-related work

Very comfortable working with numbers

Detail-oriented and organized

Able to identify discrepancies instead of simply processing transactions

Comfortable handling invoices and financial records

Able to work independently

Proactive about communicating problems

Comfortable learning new software

Able to manage confidential company and client information responsibly

Reliable and consistent

Comfortable communicating directly with company leadership

Fluent or highly proficient in spoken and written English



Excellent English communication skills are required.



Because you will answer incoming telephone calls, you must be comfortable having professional conversations with U.S.-based clients, tenants, vendors, and team members.



Preferred Experience



Any of the following would be a major advantage:



Buildium experience

Property management bookkeeping

Property management experience

Accounts payable/accounts receivable

QuickBooks or similar accounting software

Owner statement preparation

Bank/account reconciliation

Vendor invoice management

Multifamily property management

Executive Assistant experience



Additional languages are a bonus.



Spanish is especially valuable, but applicants speaking other languages are also encouraged to apply.



The Person We're Looking For



We want someone who takes ownership of their responsibilities.



For example, if you notice that a property has $3,000 in upcoming invoices but only $1,000 available in its account, we don't want you to simply enter the bills and move on.



We want you to recognize the issue, investigate it, and tell the President:



"This property does not currently have enough funds available to cover its outstanding bills. Here is the current balance, here are the outstanding invoices, and here is the amount we are short."



That type of proactive thinking is extremely valuable to us.



As our company continues to grow, this position has the opportunity to become an increasingly important part of our organization.



How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



A brief introduction about yourself and your work experience.

Your bookkeeping/accounting experience.

Any experience with Buildium or other property management software.

Include the phrase Space Coast in the subject of your application

Any experience reviewing financial statements or owner reports.

Your experience answering U.S.-based business phone calls.

The languages you speak and your proficiency in each.

Your expected monthly salary in USD.

Your available working hours in U.S. Eastern Time.



We are looking for someone interested in becoming a long-term member of our team—not simply completing occasional tasks.



If you are organized, financially minded, comfortable communicating with people, and enjoy finding problems before they become bigger problems, we'd like to hear from you.

PAY STRUCTURE

- Extras beyond the agreed amount: $3 per talking head, $10 per reel

- Paid monthly, always on time



YOU'RE A GREAT FIT IF YOU



- Have real CapCut experience (show me examples)

- Follow instructions and templates exactly – this job is about consistency

- Can reliably deliver next-day turnaround 6 days a week

- Have a laptop, stable internet and your own Instagram account

- Understand Reels: hooks, captions, pacing

- Communicate proactively – if something's unclear, you ask instead of guessing



WHAT YOU GET



- A fixed monthly income, paid on time every month

- A paid test task + paid trial

- Full style guide, CapCut template and Loom walkthroughs

- A long-term role with raises for consistent performance

- Direct work with me and fast feedback



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with the word "OUTLIER" so I know you read this. Include:

1. A short note on your CapCut experience

2. 2-3 example reels you've edited

3. Confirmation you can deliver edits by 07:00 UK time daily

title: Online Business Manager & Team Lead
description:
Online Business Manager & Team Lead



The Webinar Room is a membership for course creators and coaches who want their webinars to convert. We launched in May 2026 and have 330+ members across the US, Canada, Europe, and Australia. We also run Swedish-language programs for entrepreneurs. All team communication is in English.



I'm Emelie, the founder, with 16 years of experience in online education. I work a focused four-hour day and spend my time on strategy, teaching, and launches. I'm looking for someone to take care of our team, so that everyone knows what to do, feels supported, and can move forward without me.



What you'll own



• The team, first and foremost. Regular 1:1s with each person, knowing how they're doing, what they need, and what's in their way. You're the one they come to, not me.

• Protecting my focus. You're the first point of contact for the team. You filter what reaches me and batch it into my fixed Slack windows.

• Onboarding new team members, including our new Customer Support & Operations Assistant, with clear roles, playbooks, and a good start.

• Weekly team check-ins: priorities, follow-up, and clear, kind conversations when something isn't working.

• Asana as our single source of truth, so everyone can see what they own and by when.

• Coordinating launches and projects together with the team: 3–4 launches per year, plus migrations, evergreen funnels, and live events.

• A weekly report to me: how the team is doing, what's on track, and what needs my decision.

• Improving processes and documentation, using Claude to build reusable systems.



Our team members are independent contractors, so you'll lead through clarity, trust, and agreements rather than hierarchy.



What success looks like after 90 days



The team runs its weekly priorities without me, every project lives in Asana, support answers within one business day, and our next launch ships on time.



Must have



• 3+ years leading a team in an online course, membership, or coaching business, with people management as a core part of your role.

• A warm, direct leadership style: you build trust and still hold people accountable.

• Hands-on launch experience (webinars,
 sequences, sales periods).

• Strong Asana skills. Kajabi and ThriveCart experience is a big plus.

• Confidence using Claude for practical work, with the judgment to review its output.

• Excellent written English and a calm, structured way of working.

• Reliable overlap with Central European Time mornings (roughly 8 am–12 pm CET), Monday–Friday.



Tools: Asana, Slack, Kajabi, ThriveCart, Stripe, Claude, and Google Workspace.



Terms



Monthly retainer plus a performance bonus. The role starts at around 80 hours per month (about 20 hours per week), with more during launch weeks, and the goal of growing into a full-time role. A 90-day trial period applies. Confidentiality and data-processing agreements are required.



To apply



Send 3–5 sentences on why this role fits you and your available hours in CET. Tell us about a team you've led: its size, what you were responsible for, and one situation where you had to hold someone accountable.



Also answer this scenario briefly:

A long-time team member has missed two deadlines and seems unmotivated, and the rest of the team is starting to notice. How do you handle it during the first week, and what do you bring to me?



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a paid exercise: turn a messy project list into a prioritized Asana plan and write a first weekly report.



Start: As soon as possible.

title: Video Editor for Disaster Documentary YouTube Channel
description:
We’re building a disaster documentary channel, real historical events (volcanic eruptions, hurricanes, tornadoes, plane crashes, industrial disasters) told through archival footage and narration. We have a specific house style and need an editor who can learn and execute it consistently, not just edit generically.



House style: Built primarily from real archival/news/found footage matched closely to narration stock or AI visuals only as fallback for generic shots, never a substitute. Footage eras kept deliberately distinct (older archival for the historical event, modern drone only for present-day establishing shots) no visible era mismatches. Hard cuts only, cinematic pacing (3–6 sec avg shots) with slow burn holds at suspense peaks. Restrained captions with single word red emphasis. Chapter structure with re-hooks to sustain retention across 18–20 min.

You’ll be doing:

 • Sourcing real footage matching the script (a research skill as much as editing)

 • Cutting to pacing targets above, hard cuts only

 • Opening each video with a 60–120 sec flash-forward montage building to the title card

 • House graphics: date/location stamps, running clock through the event, map overlays with pins, stat counters/witness cards where relevant

 • Preserving original archival audio (news broadcast, radio, 911 calls) under narration where it exists, rather than replacing it

 • Sound design: steady music bed, deliberate silence before key reveals, one stinger per major beat

 • Structuring into acts with spoken re-hooks between them

Requirements:

 • Portfolio showing real sourced footage not stock slideshow with zoom

 • Comfortable matching narration to specific real world footage

 • Experience with long form (15+ min) YouTube editing, retention-focused pacing

 • Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or CapCut Pro



To apply, include:

 1. Link to your most relevant work (must be your own file ownership will be checked)

 2. Whether you’re open to a short paid test clip (2–3 min) before full commitment

 3. Your usual turnaround per 15–20 min video



Wage/Salary: $40-$60 per video (ongoing weekly work for the right fit)

s are handled quickly

Customer Support & Operations Assistant



The Webinar Room is a membership for course creators and coaches who want their webinars to convert. We launched in May 2026 and have 330+ members across the US, Canada, Europe, and Australia.



I’m Emelie, the founder, with 16 years of experience in online education. We’re a small, warm team with a direct communication style.



We’re looking for a support and operations assistant who is available during US business hours (roughly 9 am–5 pm ET), so members don’t have to wait a full day for a login fix. You should also be comfortable working with Claude and helping us build practical systems that make our day-to-day work easier.



What you’ll own



- The support inbox: logins, access, billing, refunds according to policy, plan questions, and “where do I find…?” requests, answered within one business day using our written FAQ.

- Admin questions in our member community during US hours, directing members to
 when needed.

- Welcoming new members during launch weeks, when 150–200 members may join in a single week, several times a year.

- A short written summary every Friday, flagging recurring questions and opportunities to improve the FAQ.

- Working with us to create and improve systems, processes, and documentation, using Claude to help develop reusable templates, workflows, and simple automations.



You’ll work from a written playbook and report to our support lead.



Must have



- Hands-on experience with Kajabi and ThriveCart, including member access, checkout, and refunds. This is required.

- Previous customer support experience in an online course, membership, or coaching business.

- Confidence using Claude for practical work, such as drafting documentation, improving processes, and building repeatable workflows. You know how to review its output and use your own judgment.

- The ability to help turn recurring tasks into clear, organized systems and build them collaboratively with our team.

- Warm, clear written English and a calm approach to frustrated customers.

- Reliable availability during US business hours, Monday–Friday. Some weekend availability is a plus, but not required.



Tools: Kajabi, ThriveCart, Stripe,
 Groups, Claude, Google Workspace, Asana, and Slack.



Hours and terms



We’ll start at around 10 hours per week, with more hours during launch weeks, and are open to growing the role into a full-time position. These hours should be spread across the week to support timely responses during US business hours.



A 90-day trial period applies. Confidentiality and data-processing agreements are required.



To apply



Send 3–5 sentences on why this role fits you and your available hours in ET. Include an example of how you’ve used Claude to create or improve a system, process, or workflow, explaining your contribution.



Also include a short answer to this scenario:



A customer can’t access a course they purchased, another requests a refund, and a live webinar starts in 20 minutes with a broken access link. What would you handle first and why? What would you resolve yourself, and when would you ask for help?



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a paid 1-hour exercise to prioritize a sample inbox, draft replies to two fictional customer requests, and use Claude to suggest a simple process improvement.



Start: As soon as possible.

title: Virtual Assistant – Phone Answering & Lead Coordination
description:
We are a growing local service company in Canada looking for a reliable Virtual Assistant to handle incoming customer calls, collect job information, organize leads, and coordinate with our subcontractors.



This is a customer-facing position, so excellent spoken English and professional communication are extremely important.



What You’ll Be Doing

Answer incoming customer calls professionally and courteously

Speak with customers to understand what service they need

Collect important customer and job information, including:

Customer name

Phone number

 address

Service address

Type of job/service needed

Description of the work

Photos or other relevant information when necessary

Preferred timing

Enter customer information accurately into Google Sheets

Determine which subcontractor/service provider is responsible for that specific area

Send the job information to the appropriate subcontractor

Follow up with subcontractors when necessary

Keep the Google Sheet updated with lead/job status

Communicate professionally with customers through phone, text, and
 when required

Make sure no customer lead is missed or left without a response

Escalate unusual questions or situations to management

Requirements



You MUST:



Speak excellent English

Have clear, easy-to-understand spoken English

Have a neutral or easily understandable accent

Be comfortable speaking with Canadian customers over the phone

Have excellent customer-service skills

Be friendly, professional, and confident on calls

Be highly organized and detail-oriented

Be comfortable using Google Sheets

Have a reliable internet connection

Have a good-quality headset and quiet workspace

Be dependable and available during your scheduled hours

Be able to follow instructions and processes accurately

Important



This is NOT just a data-entry position.



You will be speaking directly with customers, so we need someone who is comfortable having natural conversations with customers and gathering the right information without sounding robotic.



You should be able to confidently say things like:



"Sure, I can help you with that. Can I get your name and the address where the work is needed?"



You should also be able to ask follow-up questions when information is missing.



Experience



Previous experience in any of the following is a plus:



Virtual assistant

Call center

Customer service

Appointment setting

Lead management

Dispatching

Home-service businesses

Junk removal

Plumbing

HVAC

Landscaping

Construction or other local service industries



Experience is helpful, but strong English communication, reliability, and willingness to learn are more important.



Who We're Looking For



We're looking for someone who:



Takes responsibility for their work

Pays attention to details

Responds quickly to customers

Doesn't need to be constantly supervised

Can follow a clear system/process

Is comfortable talking to strangers on the phone

Wants a long-term position with a growing company

How to Apply



Please send:



Your name

Your previous VA/customer-service experience

Your availability and preferred working hours

Your expected hourly rate

Your internet speed

Whether you have a quiet workspace and headset

A 1–2 minute voice recording introducing yourself and explaining your previous customer-service experience



Applications without a voice recording will not be considered.



We are looking for someone interested in a long-term position and the opportunity to grow with the company.

title: Video Editor for 2 Sales Videos (VSL) — Possible Ongoing Work
description:
